paper_setting: Code as of the ICLR 2023 release of thuml/Time-Series-Library
local_setting: Commit 4e938a1767106324dd753b2a44832bf870a0252e (2026-04) plus 10 documented patches; run_metadata.json has code_dirty = true and patches.diff is shipped with every run
difference_and_implication: Implementation has evolved between releases. paper_setting: NOT_STATED_IN_PAPER per setting (single aggregate numbers are reported; seeding and hardware are not disclosed)
local_setting: Three seeds: 2021 (the value hard-coded in the official run.py), 2026 and 2027. Single RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (6 GB). CUDA 11.8, torch 2.7.1+cu118, cuDNN 90100.
difference_and_implication: Seed handling cannot be aligned with the paper. Reporting a 3-seed mean +/- sample SD instead of a single number is a stricter, not looser, comparison. cuDNN non-determinism means bit-identical cross-machine reproduction is not expected.

paper_setting: The paper reports MSE and MAE over the test set; the exact averaging is not documented
local_setting: MSE/MAE recomputed by member B's evaluator: predictions and truth are inverse-transformed to raw units, then rescaled by the training-period standard deviation. Every origin-lead-variable triple is weighted equally. OT errors are additionally reported in raw units.
difference_and_implication: Equal weighting per triple can differ slightly from an implementation that averages batch means. This is one plausible source of the sub-percent residual differences.
